plan: A time assassin who rewinds a few seconds to heal and dodge.
aSurveiller: His R (Chronobreak). He returns to where he was 4 seconds ago and heals: watch his shadow, he will reappear there.
contrer: Watch his shadow: with his R he returns to that spot and deals damage there.
Get out of his W zone: it stuns you if it explodes with him inside.
Engage him once his R is used: he has no escape left.
faiblesses: Fragile if he misses his spells.
His W takes a long time to arrive.

sorts.P: On the 3rd hit, bonus damage and speed.
sorts.Q: Grenade that slows and comes back.
sorts.W: Zone that stuns after a delay.
sorts.R: Goes back 4 seconds in time and heals.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 6. He scales with his first item and becomes very strong around 2 items.
